newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi coffee prices firm at auction.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi coffee prices firm at auction.

text.p: Coffee prices were firm at the weekly Kenyan coffee auction on Tuesday, boosted by the presence of good quality coffee, traders said.
"Traders were also buying heavily because of an expected shortage in coffee consuming countries, which pushed prices up,"another trader said.
Grade Cs averaged $207 per 50-kg bag from $197 last week, while grade ABs averaged $212 from $206.
The coffee board said it sold all 30,511 60-kg bags it offered for sale compared to 21,765 bags sold last week.
